title: Dr. Eggman's EGGS
description: Replaces the eggs with Dr. Eggman stylized eggs
body: Replaces the eggs with little Dr. Eggman from Sonic the Hedgehog series! Or Dr. Ivo Robotnik if you will, based on his classic appearance from Sonic 2 on the Sega Genesis (or Sega Mega Drive). He also blinks once in a while. Have fun!
